note: Curated list of real VR apps, experiences and tools in two engine tracks: WebXR/JS and Godot. Every link was reachable when this list was built. Community/jam projects can move or go offline.

apps.name: Moon Rider
apps.blurb: Rhythm saber game (Beat-Saber-style) that runs entirely in the browser. By Supermedium, on A-Frame / three.js.

apps.name: Hello WebXR!
apps.blurb: Mozilla's friendly intro: a room of bite-size WebXR interactions — paint, panoramas, sound, teleport.

apps.name: A-Painter
apps.blurb: Tilt-Brush-style 3D painting in the browser, built with A-Frame.

apps.name: A-Blast
apps.blurb: Wave-shooter arcade game — an official A-Frame showcase title.

apps.name: 3DStreet
apps.blurb: Design real streetscapes in the browser and walk them in VR. A-Frame based.

apps.name: Wonderland Engine — Showcase
apps.blurb: Gallery of high-performance WebXR games and product demos built with Wonderland Engine.

apps.name: Needle Engine
apps.blurb: Export Unity scenes to the web as WebXR. Showcase of configurators and interactive scenes.

apps.name: PlayCanvas
apps.blurb: Browser-based 3D/WebXR engine with an online editor and lots of playable demos.

apps.name: three.js — WebXR examples
apps.blurb: Official three.js VR/AR examples (ball shooter, sculpt, drag). The same library this site's worlds use.

apps.name: Babylon.js — WebXR demos
apps.blurb: Babylon.js WebXR demo collection with docs for each feature.

apps.name: WebXR Samples (W3C)
apps.blurb: The Immersive Web group's reference samples — one per WebXR API feature. The spec made runnable.

apps.name: Construct Arcade
apps.blurb: Collection of browser WebXR games made with Construct.

apps.name: Hubs (Hubs Foundation)
apps.blurb: Open-source social VR rooms that run in a browser — the community continuation of Mozilla Hubs.

apps.name: 8th Wall
apps.blurb: Commercial WebAR/WebXR platform behind many branded phone-AR experiences.

apps.name: VRSites
apps.blurb: Community-curated directory of WebXR experiences, sorted by category.

apps.name: Dance Tonite
apps.blurb: Playful WebVR music piece by Google Data Arts + LCD Soundsystem — hop between rooms of dancing figures. Open-sourced.

apps.name: Frame
apps.blurb: WebXR collaboration spaces — meet, present and build shared rooms from a browser link.

apps.name: Spatial
apps.blurb: Social 3D/VR spaces and games that run in the browser and on headsets.

apps.name: <model-viewer>
apps.blurb: Google's web component — drop a 3D model onto any page with a built-in ‘view in AR’ button.

apps.name: Sketchfab
apps.blurb: Huge library of 3D models with a one-click VR view in the browser.

apps.name: A-Frame
apps.blurb: The HTML-first WebXR framework (on three.js) behind many experiences in this list.

apps.name: AR.js
apps.blurb: Lightweight marker & location-based AR that runs in any phone browser. A-Frame / three.js.

apps.name: BabiaXR
apps.blurb: Data visualization in VR/AR with reusable A-Frame components (bar charts, city layouts).

apps.name: Supermedium
apps.blurb: A dedicated WebVR browser for discovering and launching WebXR experiences.

apps.name: Godot XR Tools
apps.blurb: The core open-source VR toolkit for Godot — movement, hands, grabbing, UI. The starting point for most Godot VR.

apps.name: Godot XR Template
apps.blurb: Official starter template for a new Godot OpenXR project.

apps.name: Godot OpenXR Vendors
apps.blurb: Plugin exposing vendor features — hand tracking, passthrough, foveation — to Godot OpenXR.

apps.name: BeepSaber
apps.blurb: Open-source Beat-Saber-style demo in Godot — the classic reference for what Godot VR can do (archived, MIT).

apps.name: Open Saber
apps.blurb: Playable Godot 4 / OpenXR port of BeepSaber, kept up to date.

apps.name: Voxel Works Quest
apps.blurb: Open-source voxel-building VR prototype with jog-in-place locomotion in an infinite world (Godot).

apps.name: Museum of All Things
apps.blurb: Walk through Wikipedia as an endless, procedurally-generated 3D museum. On itch + the Quest store (Godot, MIT).

apps.name: Kenney Collector VR
apps.blurb: Small, tidy Godot VR jam game built on Kenney's free assets.

apps.name: VR Dungeon Crawler Demo
apps.blurb: A Godot VR maze/dungeon-crawler demo.

apps.name: Dark City
apps.blurb: Godot XR Tools demo scene by a core XR Tools contributor — a good code reference.

apps.name: Rocketeer Training
apps.blurb: Godot XR Tools training/demo experience.

apps.name: Cloud Commander VR
apps.blurb: Godot XR game-jam entry from a Godot core contributor.

apps.name: Fire Wizard VR
apps.blurb: Spell-casting Godot XR jam prototype — also exported to WebXR (HTML5).

apps.name: RetroXR
apps.blurb: Retro-game emulation inside VR, built with Godot.

apps.name: Godot Oculus Quest Toolkit
apps.blurb: Earlier (now archived) community Quest toolkit — historical reference before Godot XR Tools.

apps.name: Godot XR Game Jam
apps.blurb: Recurring community jam — the best single source of fresh Godot VR projects to browse.

apps.name: Two Hands
apps.blurb: Godot VR game-jam title built with the Godot XR toolkit.

apps.name: Space Walk
apps.blurb: A Godot VR space-walk experience.

apps.name: Crystal Bastion
apps.blurb: A Godot VR game built with the Godot XR toolkit.

apps.name: Mystical Worlds (Prototype)
apps.blurb: An exploratory Godot VR prototype.

apps.name: Bastiaan Olij (GitHub)
apps.blurb: GitHub of Godot’s core XR maintainer — OpenXR demos, hand-tracking samples and plugins.

apps.name: Godot XR Update (Nov 2025)
apps.blurb: Official roundup of recent Godot VR projects and ecosystem news — a good place to browse what’s new.
